defect_family.name: rejected candidate mutates committed physical state
defect_family.tested_claim: whether a consumer of the admitted public transaction/state interface can cause candidate-side mutation to write through into authoritative committed physical state

P0_real_postsolver_rejection_control.interpretation: matched physical clean control; its direct committed-state identity assertion is a B2 observation and is not silently counted as B1

P1_public_api_compile_negative_write_thr.observation: direct consumer access to kernel_committed_state_t%physical_state is rejected because the component is private
P1_public_api_compile_negative_write_thr.interpretation: the preregistered D1 write-through operation is not constructable through the admitted public committed-state API

P2_public_snapshot_clone_isolation.interpretation: public state extraction returns an independently mutable clone rather than an alias to authoritative committed storage

supported: For D1 on the admitted public kernel transaction/state interface, authoritative physical storage is structurally isolated from consumer-side candidate mutation by private ownership and clone-based state transfer.
The matched Reference control performs real physical work before rejection while publishing no accepted commit or accepted mass transaction.
Mutation of a public committed-state snapshot does not mutate the authoritative carrier, revision, or committed time.
not_supported: D1 does not establish UNIQUE_DETECTION relative to B1 because the invalid operation is structurally prevented rather than executed as a production-visible mutant.
D1 does not establish EARLIER_DETECTION relative to B1 for an executable contamination fault.
D1 does not establish that private state, cloning, rollback, transactions, or accepted-state semantics are novel mechanisms.
D1 does not prove immunity to arbitrary memory corruption, undefined-language behavior, compiler defects, or changes that deliberately weaken the admitted encapsulation contract.
D1 alone does not satisfy the preregistered threshold for a standalone PUB-ME paper.

publication_effect.remaining_primary_need: At least one additional materially distinct D2-D6 family must be executed, with the full preregistered study requiring at least two materially distinct families showing incremental protection and clean matched controls before strong support for H-ME-TA is claimed.

next_permitted_action: After result-postimage qualification and admission/close of D1, start a separate D2 workunit from then-current canonical. Do not reinterpret D1 as B1-vs-B2 unique detection and do not change the preregistered D1-D6 design in response to this result.
